run_rectify_aria: run the script to rectify Aria fisheye camera images and output pinhole transforms
run_undistort_image: run the undistort_image function to convert a fisheye frame to a pinhole projection
run_process_frame: run the process_frame function to rectify a single Aria frame and return its metadata
run_get_vignette_by_name: run the get_vignette_by_name function to generate undistorted vignette maps for each camera
run_get_mask_by_name: run the get_mask_by_name function to generate circular validity masks for each camera
